name: Mi tamagotchi esta Vivo?!
source:
Finding a damaged Tamagotchi after a rough day, a young person takes it home – only to discover it's far from ordinary.

[From [url=https://artmisaa.itch.io/mi-tamagotchi-esta-vivo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人在经历了艰难的一天后发现了一只损坏的电子宠物，他把它带回家，却发现它非同寻常。

[来自[url=https://artmisaa.itch.io/mi-tamagotchi-esta-vivo]Itch.io[/url]]
